t: Makita 18V LXT DLX2537ST twin pack containing brushless combi drill and impact driver. Compact, lightweight DHP490 combi drill with brushless motor delivers strong performance and efficiency, delivering 65Nm maximum torque for demanding tasks. Includes 2-speed gearbox for switching between high speed and high torque, an electric brake, and a variable speed trigger for full control during drilling. DTD153 impact driver features an extra-compact, brushless design for fast, efficient driving. Delivers a powerful 170Nm of fastening torque, making it ideal for demanding tasks. Includes 1/4" hex drive shank and built-in LED light for better visibility in low-light conditions. Twin kit supplied with 2 x 5.0Ah LXT batteries, single-port charger, and a Makpac carry case for easy transport and storage.
